decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing low-cost aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal massive amounts of damage. With a companion like Jegantha, the Wellspring to provide additional mana ramp, the deck aims to consistently put pressure on the opponent while maintaining card advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Fatal Push and Titan's Strength allows for removal and pump effects to further enhance the deck's aggressive strategy. By leveraging efficient creatures and impactful burn spells, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to win the game through relentless aggression and burst damage.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to control the board through counterspells, removal, and card advantage with cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan with cards like Supreme Verdict and No More Lies, while also generating value through Yorion, Sky Nomad's ability to flicker cards for additional ETB triggers. The mana base includes utility lands like Field of Ruin and Hengegate Pathway to help disrupt the opponent's resources, while also providing stable mana fixing for the deck's color requirements.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy through the use of powerful creatures and enchantments. The deck utilizes cards that allow for strong board presence while also having the ability to search for key pieces and disrupt the opponent's plans. The inclusion of the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad adds an extra layer of versatility and control to the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around combining powerful creatures with enchantments to create a strong defensive and disruptive strategy in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Greasefang Parhelion combo, utilizing cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate mana and card advantage. Fear of Missing Out and Thoughtseize help ensure the combo pieces are protected and opponents' defenses are dismantled. Additional removal and disruption spells like Fatal Push and Bitter Triumph keep the opponent off balance while Liliana of the Veil provides additional control. The deck also includes some powerful threats like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Hazoret the Fervent to apply pressure and close out games.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on playing efficient and aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing powerful creatures like Knight-Errant of Eos, Venerated Loxodon, and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, along with disruptive spells like Imodane's Recruiter and Gleeful Demolition, the deck aims to establish early board presence and apply pressure to opponents. With a mix of creature synergy and removal spells, this deck looks to outpace opponents and close out games before they can stabilize.

This aggro Jund deck focuses on using efficient creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil alongside sacrifice outlets like Witch's Oven to control the board and drain the opponent's life total. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. The overall strategy is to apply pressure early and maintain control of the board to close out the game quickly.

The deck utilizes the combo of Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary. It also includes disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Torch the Tower. The deck's win condition revolves around flipping Case of the Stashed Skeleton to bring back multiple threats from the graveyard, creating a difficult board state for the opponent to deal with. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana fixing and ramp capability.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Transmogrify combo to cheat powerful creatures onto the battlefield. By using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Case of the Stashed Skeleton, the deck aims to consistently find and play key pieces of the combo. With cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Reckoner Bankbuster, the deck can control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up for the combo. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and versatility to the deck's overall game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of spells and creatures to generate powerful effects and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By casting spells such as Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Indomitable Creativity, the player can create creatures like Valgavoth, Terror Eater and Vaultborn Tyrant to overwhelm the opponent. Caretaker's Talent and Chained to the Rocks offer additional utility and removal options, while High Noon provides protection for key creatures. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy and ensure consistent casting of powerful spells.

The deck revolves around utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to sacrifice creatures and fetch powerful threats from the deck, controlling the board and out-valuing the opponent. It also focuses on resolving Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate value and card advantage. The deck includes a variety of powerful creatures, spells, and lands to support the control strategy. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck. Overall, the key concept is to control the game through sacrificing creatures and generating value with Enigmatic Incarnation.

This deck revolves around assembling the Lotus Field combo to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful spells quickly. It includes cards that help tutor for Lotus Field, untap it, protect it, and search for key combo pieces. The goal is to utilize the high mana production to cast game-winning spells such as Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. The Fae of Wishes provides additional versatility and toolbox options. The deck also includes some control elements and defensive cards to stall the game until the combo can be assembled.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Lotus Field combo to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful spells. By utilizing cards like Strict Proctor and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to untap Lotus Field, along with ramp spells like Sylvan Scrying and Bala Ged Recovery, the deck aims to create a game-winning scenario with cards like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. Additionally, having control elements like Archdruid's Charm and Nine Lives helps protect the combo and stall the game until the win condition is achieved.

The deck focuses on using various cards to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also generating card advantage with Niv-Mizzet Reborn. The key strategy revolves around using Bring to Light to tutor for specific answers or threats, with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker providing additional card advantage. The deck features a diverse range of spells, creatures, and lands to handle different situations and is further enhanced by the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad for added value and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent while maintaining control of the game.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells to deal damage efficiently. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, along with pump spells like Titan's Strength and Monstrous Rage, the deck aims to deal quick and consistent damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Callous Sell-Sword also helps maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Reckless Rage to deal with opposing threats.

The deck focuses on using Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Reckoner Bankbuster. It also includes disruption and removal spells like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Torch the Tower to control the board. The deck has a companion in Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional synergy. Additionally, it utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Case of the Stashed Skeleton for card advantage, while also incorporating some versatile threats like Hidetsugu Consumes All and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary. The deck aims to overwhelm and outvalue opponents through its combo potential and strong creatures.
